caseName: Consul General of Yugoslavia v. Pennsylvania
caseNameFull: CONSUL GENERAL OF YUGOSLAVIA AT PITTSBURGH v. PENNSYLVANIA
attorneys: Lawrence 8. Lesser, C. Francis Fisher and R. Paul Lessy for petitioner., Walter E. Alessandroni, Attorney General of Pennsylvania, and Vincent X. Yakowicz, Deputy Attorney General, for respondent., Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Douglas and Alan 8. Rosenthal for the United States, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted and the judgment is reversed. Kolovrat v. Oregon, 366 U. S. 187.
